subject: Security architecture deep-dive and SOC 2 evidence walkthrough
messages:
From: Martha Lopez <martha.lopez@bigbankcapital.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-ops@bigbankcapital.com, Alex Chen <alex.chen@consultingfirm.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 18:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: security architecture deep-dive + SOC 2 evidence review

Hi Naomi,

We're preparing for our SOC 2 readiness window and would like to schedule a focused technical walk-through of Redwood's security and compliance posture. Key items on our side: SSO/SAML flows, encryption at rest/key management, audit log retention and schema, and an inventory of SOC 2 evidence artifacts you can provide.

Proposed windows (ET):
- Thu, Jun 4 — 14:00–15:00 ET
- Fri, Jun 5 — 13:00–14:00 ET

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Cover the architecture for SSO and SCIM provisioning (who owns the IdP federation, what claims are passed)
- Share a list/map of SOC 2 artifacts and owners (e.g., syslog buckets, KMS roles)
- Provide examples of audit log export and retention policy (schema + retention periods)

If helpful, we can include our security engineering consultant (Alex Chen) for any follow-ups. We'd like an hour with technical leads (infra, security) + the engagement owner. Also please share any pre-reads.

Thanks,
Martha Lopez
Security Program Manager
BigBank Capital

--
Attachments: none (will request pre-reads after confirmation)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Martha Lopez <martha.lopez@bigbankcapital.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security architecture deep-dive + SOC 2 evidence review

Hi Martha — thanks for reaching out and the clear list. We'd be happy to run the session.

Availability: Thu, Jun 4 11:00–12:00 PDT (14:00–15:00 ET) works for our team. If that slot becomes constrained, we can move to Fri, Jun 5 10:00–11:00 PDT.

Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Naomi Feldman — Customer Success (engagement lead)
- Marissa Cole — Security PM (artifact owner)
- Karthik Iyer — Infrastructure (KMS + encryption)
- Soojin Lee — Platform Ops (audit logs + retention)

Suggested agenda (45–60 min):
1) 5 min — intros & scope
2) 15 min — architecture overview (SSO, SCIM, network boundaries, encryption model)
3) 15 min — evidence map & audit logs (what's available, formats, retention)
4) 10–20 min — Q&A and next steps (artifact handoff, timelines)

Pre-reads we can share: evidence inventory spreadsheet, network diagram, and a short KMS design note. I'll attach those after we finalize the time.

If Jun 4 11:00 PDT is confirmed I'll send a calendar invite and the pre-read Drive link.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

--
(Please note: internal coordination ongoing; Marissa will add the evidence map and network diagram.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: security architecture deep-dive + SOC 2 evidence review

Naomi — forwarding with pre-reads attached. Karthik and I will split the architecture portion: Karthik will own the KMS/encryption slides and example policies; I'll walk through the evidence map and owners.

Quick notes:
- Attached: network-diagram.png (high level boundary diagram), SOC2_evidence_map_v2.xlsx (artifact inventory, owner, sample paths), redwood-security-playbook.pdf (ops runbook excerpt).
- For audit logs: Soojin, can you surface a small export sample (anonymized) for their review? Ideally a single-day sample with common event types (auth, model-access, admin changes).
- We should confirm whether BigBank needs longer retention copies — our default retention is 90 days for hot logs, 365 days archived; we can propose extended export for SOC 2 review.

Marissa
Security PM, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- network-diagram.png (image/png)
- SOC2_evidence_map_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- redwood-security-playbook.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Martha Lopez <martha.lopez@bigbankcapital.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@consultingfirm.io>, security-ops@bigbankcapital.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: security architecture deep-dive + SOC 2 evidence review

Thanks Naomi and Marissa — the materials look good. One hiccup: the proposed Thu, Jun 4 14:00 ET slot conflicts with our legal onboarding sync. Is it possible to move to Fri, Jun 5 at 13:00 ET instead (which I believe maps to 10:00 PDT)? That would give our security lead and legal a chance to attend.

Also two asks before the call:
- Could you provide an anonymized sample audit log export (one day) and a short readme describing the fields?
- Confirm whether KMS key rotation is fully automated or manual (and who has key-admin rights).

If you confirm Fri at 13:00 ET I'll have legal and the security lead join.

Regards,
Martha
Security Program Manager
BigBank Capital

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Martha Lopez <martha.lopez@bigbankcapital.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security architecture deep-dive + SOC 2 evidence review

Hi Martha — Fri, Jun 5 10:00–11:00 PDT (13:00–14:00 ET) is confirmed. I've sent a calendar invite (link below) and shared the pre-reads to a Drive folder.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Audit log sample: Soojin will upload an anonymized one-day export plus a short README that maps the fields to event types.
- KMS rotation: rotation is automated on a 90-day schedule; key-admin roles are limited to infra SRE and a small set of security engineers. Karthik will cover the precise IAM roles in the call.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-bigbank-deepdive-20270605
Pre-read Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-pre-reads

Agenda will follow the plan I shared earlier. If you need us to carve out extra time for legal, we can extend by 15–30 minutes.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments referenced: SOC2_evidence_map_v2.xlsx, network-diagram.png, redwood-security-playbook.pdf
